data.title: NetzMuster price increase from 1 April 2026
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH announces that the monthly base price of your "Muster DSL 250" plan rises from €39.99 to €44.99 from 1 April 2026. You have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht).
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising the monthly price by €5.00. Because of this, you may cancel the contract without notice period and without cost within three months after you received this letter, at the earliest when the change takes effect. You can decide whether to accept the new price or cancel; the app shows until when the right to cancel applies. If you do nothing, the contract continues at the new price. You could compare other providers before deciding.
